mapper.update: UPDATE deal_notification_settings SET auto_enabled = #{autoEnabled}, send_time = #{sendTime}, last_day_enabled = #{lastDayEnabled}, updated_at = #{now}, updated_by = #{staffId} WHERE id = 1

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO deal_announcements (id, kind, trigger, announced_on, item_count, created_at, created_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{kind}, #{trigger}, #{announcedOn}, #{itemCount}, #{now}, #{staffId}) ON CONFLICT (announced_on) DO NOTHING

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO deal_push_log (announcement_id, customer_id, sent_on, branch_id, item_count, items_text, created_at) VALUES (#{announcementId}, #{customerId}, #{sentOn}, #{branchId}, #{itemCount}, CAST(#{itemsText} AS jsonb), #{now}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT l.announcement_id, l.customer_id, a.kind, l.branch_id, l.item_count, l.items_text FROM deal_push_log l JOIN deal_announcements a ON a.id = l.announcement_id WHERE l.sent_at IS NULL AND l.dropped_at IS NULL AND (l.announcement_id, l.customer_id) > (#{after.announcementId}, #{after.customerId}) ORDER BY l.announcement_id, l.customer_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE deal_push_log SET dropped_at = #{now} WHERE sent_at IS NULL AND dropped_at IS NULL AND created_at < #{before}
mapper.select: SELECT id, business_hours::text AS business_hours FROM branches WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE deal_announcements SET delivered = delivered + 1 WHERE id = #{announcementId}
UPDATE deal_push_log SET opened_at = #{now} WHERE announcement_id = #{announcementId} AND customer_id = #{customerId} AND opened_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.kind, a.trigger, a.announced_on, a.item_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM deal_push_log l WHERE l.announcement_id = a.id AND l.sent_at IS NOT NULL)::int AS recipients, (SELECT count(*) FROM deal_push_log l WHERE l.announcement_id = a.id AND l.sent_at IS NULL AND l.dropped_at IS NULL)::int AS waiting, a.delivered, (SELECT count(*) FROM deal_push_log l WHERE l.announcement_id = a.id AND l.opened_at IS NOT NULL)::int AS opened, a.created_at FROM deal_announcements a ORDER BY a.announced_on DESC LIMIT #{limit}
